# Editor fonts

The editor uses **Inter Regular / Bold** for its interface and **JetBrains Mono** for code.
Noto Sans remains available to projects and font tests.

Inter is bundled from the Godot font distribution at revision
[`95c0fa5fe8a019adc29d074c16b64469b04571f7`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/tree/95c0fa5fe8a019adc29d074c16b64469b04571f7/thirdparty/fonts).
`Inter_Regular.woff2` and `Inter_Bold.woff2` were decompressed to TTF containers with
fontTools 4.68.0 / Brotli 1.2.1. The font outlines and names are unchanged.
Their SIL Open Font License is reproduced in `Inter-OFL.txt` and distributed with the editor.

| File | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| Inter-Regular.ttf | e22dc39872f48ae4ad0b141e6ada375df4d7153a3854be01c4ff9c7fa75fada3 |
| Inter-Bold.ttf | e718d5d8ec4b23c3d78a3ca7d37da244a76f6afd1752b39d9240d276686a023f |

The other bundled fonts retain their licenses in `NotoSans-OFL.txt` and
`JetBrainsMono-OFL.txt`.
